verse.verse_1: Indeed there has been a time for man, when even his name did not exist anywhere.
verse.verse_2: Indeed We have created man from mixed semen; in order to test him – We therefore made him hearing, knowing.
verse.verse_3: We have indeed shown him the way – whether he is grateful or ingrate.
verse.verse_4: We have indeed kept prepared chains, and shackles and a blazing fire for the disbelievers.
verse.verse_5: Indeed the virtuous will drink from a cup, containing a mixture of Kafoor.
verse.verse_6: The Kafoor is a spring, from which the chosen bondmen of Allah will drink, causing it to flow wherever they wish inside their palaces.
verse.verse_7: They fulfil their pledges, and fear a day the evil of which is widespread.
verse.verse_8: And out of His love, they give food to the needy, the orphan and the prisoner.
verse.verse_9: They say to them, “We give you food, only for the sake of Allah – we do not seek any reward or thanks from you.”
verse.verse_10: “Indeed we fear from our Lord a day which is extremely bitter, most severe.”
verse.verse_11: So Allah saved them from the evil of that day, and gave them freshness and joy.
verse.verse_12: And gave them Paradise and silk clothes, as a reward for their patience.
verse.verse_13: Reclining in it, upon thrones; they will not see the hot sunshine in it, nor the bitter cold.
verse.verse_14: And its shade will cover them, and its fruit clusters brought down low for them.
verse.verse_15: Rounds of silver cups and silver beakers, looking like glass, will be presented upon them.
verse.verse_16: Glass made from silver, which the servers have filled up to the measure.
verse.verse_17: And in Paradise they will be given to drink cups, filled with a mixture of ginger.
verse.verse_18: Which is a spring in Paradise called Salsabeel.
verse.verse_19: Immortal youths shall surround them, waiting upon them; when you see them, you would think they are scattered pearls.
verse.verse_20: And when you look towards it, you will see serenity and a great kingdom.
verse.verse_21: In it they adorn clothes of fine green silk and gold embroidery; and they are given silver bracelets to wear; and their Lord gave them pure wine to drink.
verse.verse_22: It will be said to them, “This is your reward – indeed your efforts have been appreciated.”
verse.verse_23: Indeed We have sent down the Qur’an upon you, in stages.
verse.verse_24: Therefore stay patient upon your Lord’s command, and do not listen to any of the sinners or ingrates among them.
verse.verse_25: And remember the name of your Lord morning and evening.
verse.verse_26: And prostrate for Him in a part of the night, and proclaim His purity into the long night.
verse.verse_27: Indeed these people love what they have, the fleeting one, and have forsaken the immensely important day behind them.
verse.verse_28: It is We Who created them, and strengthened their skeleton; and We can replace them with others like them, whenever We will.
verse.verse_29: This is indeed an advice; so whoever wishes may take the path towards his Lord.
verse.verse_30: And what will you wish, except if Allah wills; indeed Allah is All Knowing, Wise.
verse.verse_31: He admits into His mercy, whomever He wills; and for the unjust He has kept prepared a painful punishment.
